mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store ( user_id, store_name, store_add1, store_add2, store_tel ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{storeName}, #{storeAdd1}, #{storeAdd2}, #{storeTel} )
mapper.select: SELECT store_id AS storeId, store_name AS storeName, store_add1 AS storeAdd1, store_add2 AS storeAdd2, store_tel AS storeTel FROM store WHERE store_id = #{storeId}
